gravy = a brown sauce made from meat juices
stew = meat and vegetables cooked slowly in liquid
salad dressing = a sauce of oil and vinegar (or similar) for salad
smoothie = a thick cold drink of blended fruit
lemonade = a sweet drink made with lemon
herbal tea = a hot drink made from herbs, not black tea
sip = to drink a very small amount at a time
chew = to bite food many times before you swallow
swallow = to make food or drink go down your throat
bite = to cut food with your teeth; a small piece you eat
side dish = a small extra dish served with the main course
